description: Implementation of debug state management for OpenGL and EGL in the ANGLE project, including message logging, callback handling, and debug group control.

classes.name: Debug::Control
classes.description: Controls message filtering for debug groups.

classes.name: Debug::Group
classes.description: Represents a group of debug messages with associated controls.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: Manages debug message logging, callbacks, and groups for OpenGL and EGL.

methods.name: setMaxLoggedMessages
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of messages to log.

methods.name: setOutputEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug output.

methods.name: isOutputEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug output is enabled.

methods.name: setOutputSynchronous
methods.description: Sets whether debug output is synchronous.

methods.name: isOutputSynchronous
methods.description: Checks if debug output is synchronous.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function for debug messages.

methods.name: getCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the current callback function.

methods.name: getUserParam
methods.description: Retrieves the user parameter for callback.

methods.name: insertMessage
methods.description: Logs a debug message with specified severity and type.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves stored debug messages.

methods.name: getNextMessageLength
methods.description: Returns length of the next message.

methods.name: getMessageCount
methods.description: Returns the number of stored messages.

methods.name: setMessageControl
methods.description: Sets message filtering controls.

methods.name: pushGroup
methods.description: Pushes a new debug group onto the stack.

methods.name: popGroup
methods.description: Pops the current debug group.

methods.name: getGroupStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the current depth of the group stack.

methods.name: isMessageEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a message with given source, type, id, severity is enabled.

methods.name: pushDefaultGroup
methods.description: Pushes the default debug group.

methods.name: setCallback (egl::Debug)
methods.description: Sets the EGL debug callback and message types.

methods.name: getCallback (egl::Debug)
methods.description: Retrieves the EGL debug callback.

methods.name: isMessageTypeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific EGL message type is enabled.

methods.name: insertMessage (egl::Debug)
methods.description: Logs an EGL debug message.
